description: This PHP script handles the rendering of the label editing view within the SuiteCRM module. It initializes styles, retrieves language strings, and dynamically generates the HTML interface for editing labels based on request parameters. The code manages template assignment and output for different display styles, such as embedded or popup views.

classes.name: XTemplate
classes.description: A template engine class used to render HTML with placeholders for dynamic content.

methods.description: Retrieves language-specific strings for a given module.
